description: Upload local files and/or folders to Pandafile and get a share link (https://pandafile.co/d/<id>). Folders are sent with their structure. Large files are fine (resumable, chunked uploads); the call returns when the upload is complete. If recipients are given, each gets an email with a personal download link. Returns the link, id, expiry and sizes. Only send files the user asked you to send.

expires_at.description: Exact expiry as ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-12-31T23:00:00Z"). Alternative to expires_in_days; same limits.

expires_in_days.description: Keep the files this many days from now (1–90). Pro/Team only, at most 90 days after sending; not for test keys. Leave out for the plan default.

message.description: Message to the recipients (up to 1000 characters).

password.description: Download password (8–200 characters). Recipients need it to download. Plus/Pro/Team only.

paths.description: Absolute paths of files or folders on this computer (~ is expanded), e.g. ["/Users/ada/Desktop/final-cut.mov", "/Users/ada/Desktop/stills"].

recipients.description: Email addresses to send the link to. Leave out to just get a link.

title.description: Title shown on the download page and in emails (up to 120 characters).

name: send_files
title: Send files with Pandafile
